definition: Exposed to coordinate containers. Pod-network traffic between containers, ports unpublished, callers allowlisted per seam with Bearer tokens and fail-closed boot on empty allowlists.
because: This repo runs no containers and joins no pod network. Its one seam is a stdlib HTTP server started by hand on loopback for the language matrix; there is nothing here for a container to coordinate with. The pod-internal seams live in magentic-stack (back, vault, bus, persist, mind, switch data plane).
note: Present and empty on purpose. Rule 2: an omitted scope cannot be told apart from an overlooked one.
